stories.title: Shot, cut and graded by me
stories.text:
From the first frame to the final grade, I look after the whole production: planning, filming, lighting, editing and colour.

My background in music technology means I understand sound as well as picture, which shapes how I frame, cut and finish every project.
stories.photoAlt: Alex filming a band in the studio

stories.title: Your band, filmed live in the room
stories.text:
Over 1,000 sessions filmed at The Silk Mill Recording Studios: multi-camera video with studio-quality sound, recorded, mixed and mastered by audio engineer Jim Hodgkinson.

Packages, prices, the studio and how booking works are all on the Live In Session page.
